name: Evolution
summary: Players evolve species with trait cards, grow body size and population, and compete for limited food while carnivores hunt.
rules_text: Each player starts with one species at size 1 pop 1. Each round has four phases. 1) Deal: each player gets 3 cards plus 1 per species they own. If deck runs out to shuffle, game ends after this or next round. 2) Select Food: each player secretly places one trait card face-down on Watering Hole; its bottom number is plant food added this round. 3) Play Cards clockwise from first player: each trait card may be played face-down as a trait on a species (max 3, no duplicates), discarded to gain a new species at 1/1 to left or right of row, or discarded to increase a species' body size or population by 1 up to 6. Then flip traits face-up. 4) Feeding: first player reveals food cards, sum totals and add that much plant food to hole (negative removes). In turn order each player must feed one hungry species (food < population) if possible. Herbivores take 1 plant from hole; carnivores cannot take plant and must attack a species with smaller body size and not protected by defensive traits, gaining food equal to target's body size from bank and reducing target pop by 1. If pop drops to 0 species goes extinct: discard it and draw cards equal to traits lost. Species that don't fill cannot exceed pop; at end of feeding any unfed population is reduced to food eaten, zero means extinction, and all eaten food goes to player's bag for points. Leftover plant stays. Pass first player.
rating_reason: Trait card evolution game, no board, fits hidden hands and strategy
